sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
What's new in 4.5.20
- Gift cards that let shoppers pick their own amount now show an amount box on the product page. Product cards and buy buttons show "Choose amount" and take shoppers there.
- Gift card orders keep the recipient's details when a shopper signs in during checkout, and can't be placed without them.
